lines.zh: 我在沙下走，沙面鼓起一道脊。
lines.en: I walk beneath the sand, raising a ridge behind me.

lines.zh: 恶地的红沙比沙漠更烫。
lines.en: Red badlands sand burns hotter than the open desert.

lines.zh: 每一节身体都在推沙，很慢。
lines.en: Every segment pushes sand, and it is slow going.

lines.zh: 沙从环节的缝里漏下去。
lines.en: Sand leaks out through the seams of my rings.

lines.zh: 我走过的沙面会塌成沟。
lines.en: The sand behind me collapses into a shallow trench.

lines.zh: 沙丘挡住了风，也挡住了我。
lines.en: A dune blocks the wind, and it blocks me too.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛，靠沙的震动走。
lines.en: I have no eyes; I walk by the shaking of sand.

lines.zh: 头顶的太阳晒不透三尺沙。
lines.en: The sun above cannot reach three feet down.

lines.zh: 我横穿整片沙漠，只为找湿气。
lines.en: I cross the whole desert looking for damp ground.

lines.zh: 红土很硬，我磨掉了一层皮。
lines.en: The red clay is hard, and it wore off a layer.

lines.zh: 沙暴来的时候，我走得更快。
lines.en: When the sandstorm comes, I move faster.

lines.zh: 我把头抬出沙面，只抬一寸。
lines.en: I lift my head above the sand, one inch only.

lines.zh: 沙地上那道弯，是我留下的。
lines.en: That crooked line in the sand is mine.

lines.zh: 我一路吃，一路往前钻。
lines.en: I eat as I go, and I keep going forward.

lines.zh: 我绕开岩层，那儿钻不进去。
lines.en: I swing around the bedrock. I cannot bore through it.

lines.zh: 两三条同伴在旁边的沙里跟着。
lines.en: Two or three of my kind follow through the sand beside me.

lines.zh: 我把头埋回去，等沙凉。
lines.en: I bury my head again and wait for the sand to cool.

lines.zh: 沙下很静，只有我的摩擦声。
lines.en: Under the sand it is quiet, only my own scraping.

lines.zh: 我盘成一圈，省点力气。
lines.en: I coil into a ring to save my strength.

lines.zh: 有时候，我整日不动。
lines.en: Some days I do not move at all.

lines.zh: 风把沙吹到我背上，我不抖。
lines.en: Wind piles sand on my back, and I do not shake it.

lines.zh: 恶地夜里很冷，我缩进深处。
lines.en: Badlands nights are cold, so I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有脚步，两只脚。
lines.en: Far off I hear footsteps, and there are two of them.

lines.zh: 沙里没有水，我只能等。
lines.en: There is no water in the sand, so I wait.

lines.zh: 我的环节一张一合，像呼吸。
lines.en: My rings open and close like slow breathing.

lines.zh: 头顶有秃鹫，我不在意。
lines.en: A vulture circles overhead; I do not care.

lines.zh: 沙面在动，是我在下面。
lines.en: The sand shifts. That is me below.

lines.zh: 等沙面凉了，我再出去。
lines.en: When the surface cools, I will come out.

lines.zh: 你站在沙脊上，我感到了重量。
lines.en: You stand on the ridge, and I feel the weight.

lines.zh: 我抬头，你的影子落在我嘴边。
lines.en: I raise my head into your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进沙里，很响。
lines.en: Your boots sink into the sand, very loud.

lines.zh: 你靴子陷沙的声响，就是路标。
lines.en: The sound of your boots sinking tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，沙动了一下。
lines.en: You step back, and the sand shifts once.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来看那道沟，真大胆。
lines.en: You crouch to look at that trench; bold.

lines.zh: 我的口器张开，又合上。
lines.en: My mouthparts open, then close again.

lines.zh: 你手里的水壶在响，我听见了。
lines.en: The canteen in your hand is sloshing; I hear it.

lines.zh: 你踩的这块沙，下面是我。
lines.en: The sand you stand on has me beneath it.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，这才是最要紧的。
lines.en: You cannot see me, and that is the whole point.

lines.zh: 你砍在环节的缝上，很深。
lines.en: You cut deep into the seam of my rings.

lines.zh: 我缩进沙里，血把沙粘住。
lines.en: I shrink into the sand, and blood glues it.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了你的靴子。
lines.en: With that blow, I remember your boots.

lines.zh: 我的皮裂开，流出淡黄的水。
lines.en: My hide splits and pale yellow fluid runs.

lines.zh: 疼得我把沙都吞下去了。
lines.en: It hurts so much that I swallow sand.

lines.zh: 我退了半尺，又往前拱。
lines.en: I retreat half a foot, then push forward again.

lines.zh: 你打中我的头，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You hit my head and I sway once.

lines.zh: 我挨打的时候不出声。
lines.en: I make no sound when I am struck.

lines.zh: 这段身体不要了，我甩掉它。
lines.en: This segment is ruined, so I shed it.

lines.zh: 沙会把我的血吸干净。
lines.en: The sand will drink my blood dry.

lines.zh: 你倒下的水，我先闻到湿气。
lines.en: I smell the damp first when you pour out water.

lines.zh: 一块生肉掉在沙上，我来了。
lines.en: Raw meat lands on the sand, and I arrive.

lines.zh: 你抖开毯子，那点阴影够凉。
lines.en: Shake out your blanket; that shade is cool enough.

lines.zh: 我不吃铁，我吃有水的。
lines.en: I do not eat iron; I eat things with water in them.

lines.zh: 血腥味渗进沙，比水快。
lines.en: The smell of blood soaks into sand faster than water.

lines.zh: 你放下的桶，底上还有水。
lines.en: The bottom of the bucket you set down is still wet.

lines.zh: 我跟着湿气走，一路钻。
lines.en: I follow the damp, boring straight through.

lines.zh: 那只死骆驼，够我吃三天。
lines.en: That dead camel will feed me for three days.

lines.zh: 你把肉埋浅了，我一下就找到。
lines.en: You buried the meat shallow, and I found it at once.

lines.zh: 我不挑，能咽的都行。
lines.en: I am not picky; anything I can swallow will do.

lines.zh: 你踩塌了我的沙道。
lines.en: You have caved in my tunnel.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的脚踝，很硬。
lines.en: I bump your ankle, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 沙里的骨头和你的骨头，我都撞过。
lines.en: I have hit bones in the sand and yours alike.

lines.zh: 我拱起来，把你顶了个趔趄。
lines.en: I arch up and knock you off balance.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近，我抬头撞你膝盖。
lines.en: Too close, so I raise my head into your knee.

lines.zh: 我的皮比沙粗，蹭过会红。
lines.en: My hide is coarser than sand and leaves you red.

lines.zh: 你一屁股坐在我背上。
lines.en: You sit down hard on my back.

lines.zh: 我撞开石头，沙跟着塌。
lines.en: I shove a stone aside and the sand follows.

lines.zh: 沙脊从我背上鼓起，你踩偏了。
lines.en: A sand ridge swells over my back; you misjudged your step.

lines.zh: 你踩的每块沙，都可能是我的背。
lines.en: Every patch of sand you step on might be me.

lines.zh: 每年沙暴季，我们才碰面。
lines.en: We only meet in the season of sandstorms.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴拍沙，声音传得很远。
lines.en: I slap the sand with my tail; the sound carries.

lines.zh: 她的环节比我密，也更亮。
lines.en: Her rings are denser than mine, and brighter.

lines.zh: 我们并排钻，沙面起两道脊。
lines.en: We bore side by side, leaving two ridges.

lines.zh: 我把头贴在她身上，很凉。
lines.en: I press my head against her, and it is cool.

lines.zh: 交配完，我们各自钻进沙里。
lines.en: Afterward we each sink into the sand alone.

lines.zh: 沙漠这么大，我们也找得到彼此。
lines.en: The desert is vast, yet we still find each other.

lines.zh: 她比我多一节，我一直记得。
lines.en: She has one more segment than I do; I remember.

lines.zh: 两条虫绕成一个大圈。
lines.en: Two worms circle into one great ring.

lines.zh: 今年会有更多小虫钻沙。
lines.en: There will be more small worms boring this year.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的骨头含进沙里。
lines.en: I take the fallen bone down into the sand.

lines.zh: 这袋种子，我连袋子一起吞。
lines.en: This bag of seeds goes down with the bag.

lines.zh: 你掉的镐，沉进沙子了。
lines.en: The pickaxe you dropped sinks into sand.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只埋东西。
lines.en: I do not pick things up; I bury them.

lines.zh: 那块红砂岩，我顶到边上。
lines.en: That red sandstone slab, I shove to one side.

lines.zh: 我把卵产在拾到的皮革下面。
lines.en: I lay my eggs under the leather you left.

lines.zh: 你的靴带松了，我拽了一下。
lines.en: Your bootlace came loose, so I tugged it.

lines.zh: 沙里翻出的硬币，我不认识。
lines.en: A coin turns up in the sand and means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我把一整只兔子拖进洞里。
lines.en: I drag a whole rabbit into my tunnel.

lines.zh: 别在沙上放东西，会没有。
lines.en: Do not leave things on sand; they will be gone.

lines.zh: 你踩沙的节奏，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the rhythm of your steps.

lines.zh: 四只一起，够围住一个人。
lines.en: Four of us are enough to surround one person.

lines.zh: 你的重量压在沙上，我顺着找。
lines.en: Your weight presses the sand, and I follow it down.

lines.zh: 震动从上往下传，你就是那个源。
lines.en: The shaking comes from above, and you are the source.

lines.zh: 我不追，我提前钻到你前面。
lines.en: I do not chase; I bore ahead of you.

lines.zh: 队里最慢的那个，我选他。
lines.en: I pick the slowest one in the group.

lines.zh: 你的脚印，是最好的地图。
lines.en: Your footprints make the best map I know.

lines.zh: 沙下面比上面快，你跑不赢。
lines.en: Under the sand is faster than on it; you cannot win.

lines.zh: 一共四个人，我只要一个。
lines.en: There are four of you, and I need only one.

lines.zh: 你停下来了，我就知道你在怕。
lines.en: You stopped moving, so I know you are afraid.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸让沙粒跳，很明显。
lines.en: Your breathing makes the grains jump; very clear.

lines.zh: 我从下面数脚步，一步没错。
lines.en: I count your steps from below and miss none.

lines.zh: 这片沙是我的猎场，你进来了。
lines.en: This sand is my hunting ground, and you entered it.

lines.zh: 目标在动，沙在告诉我。
lines.en: The target moves, and the sand tells me where.

lines.zh: 我钻到你脚下，慢慢往上。
lines.en: I bore under your feet and rise slowly.

lines.zh: 沙面裂开一圈，那是信号。
lines.en: A ring of sand cracks open; that is the signal.

lines.zh: 我选好角度，从侧面起。
lines.en: I pick my angle and come in from the side.

lines.zh: 队里其他人会先跑，我知道。
lines.en: The others will run first; I know that much.

lines.zh: 我把沙推到一边，不出声。
lines.en: I push the sand aside without a sound.

lines.zh: 你的靴底只有薄薄一层沙。
lines.en: There is only a thin layer of sand under your boots.

lines.zh: 我停在你正下方，等你迈步。
lines.en: I stop right beneath you and wait for a step.

lines.zh: 你回头看了，可你看的是后面。
lines.en: You looked back, but you looked behind yourself.

lines.zh: 四只虫各守一个方向。
lines.en: Four worms, each guarding a different direction.

lines.zh: 我等你把重心放在一只脚上。
lines.en: I wait until your weight rests on one foot.

lines.zh: 你越走越慢，沙越陷越深。
lines.en: The slower you walk, the deeper you sink.

lines.zh: 我把头缩回去，再猛地顶。
lines.en: I pull my head down, then strike upward.

lines.zh: 沙面的纹路变了，你没注意。
lines.en: The pattern on the sand changed, and you missed it.

lines.zh: 三、二、一，我数沙粒。
lines.en: Three, two, one; I am counting grains.

lines.zh: 我从沙里冲出来，咬住你的腰。
lines.en: I burst from the sand and bite your waist.

lines.zh: 一口下去，沙灌进你衣领。
lines.en: One bite, and sand pours down your collar.

lines.zh: 我把你拖进沙里，只露头。
lines.en: I drag you under, leaving only your head out.

lines.zh: 我的口器转着，像钻头。
lines.en: My mouthparts turn like a drill.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你肋骨响了一声。
lines.en: That blow made one of your ribs crack.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你摔在红沙上。
lines.en: I shake my head and throw you onto red sand.

lines.zh: 沙灌满你的嘴，你叫不出来。
lines.en: Sand fills your mouth, so you cannot scream.

lines.zh: 我咬住靴子，把人一起拽。
lines.en: I bite the boot and pull the whole person.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我缩回沙里再出来。
lines.en: You cut me, so I sink and come up elsewhere.

lines.zh: 半个身子陷下去，就完了。
lines.en: Sink to the waist, and it is finished.

lines.zh: 沙面鼓起四个包，我们一起来。
lines.en: Four bumps rise in the sand; we arrive together.

lines.zh: 恶地的红沙下，我醒了。
lines.en: Under the red badlands sand, I wake.

lines.zh: 太阳落山后，沙里有了动静。
lines.en: After sunset, something begins moving in the sand.

lines.zh: 这一带沙很松，正好钻。
lines.en: The sand here is loose, perfect for boring.

lines.zh: 我们从同一个洞里出来。
lines.en: We come out of the same hole.

lines.zh: 二到四只，一窝就是一队。
lines.en: Two to four of us; one clutch, one crew.

lines.zh: 沙子下面全是我们的味道。
lines.en: The smell under this sand is all ours.

lines.zh: 风停了，我出来了。
lines.en: The wind stopped, so I came out.

lines.zh: 我出生在沙丘背面，那里凉。
lines.en: I was born on the shady side of a dune.

lines.zh: 沙暴过后，新的洞到处都是。
lines.en: After the sandstorm, fresh holes are everywhere.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的环节，皮开始卷。
lines.en: Fire roasts my rings and the hide curls.

lines.zh: 我从沙脊滚下去，满嘴是沙。
lines.en: I roll down the dune with a mouth full of sand.

lines.zh: 水漫过沙，我第一次浮起来。
lines.en: Water floods the sand and I float for the first time.

lines.zh: 炸开的沙把我半截埋住。
lines.en: The blast buries half of me in sand.

lines.zh: 箭穿一节，沙从洞里漏出来。
lines.en: An arrow pierces a segment and sand leaks through.

lines.zh: 紫光打进沙里，环节发麻。
lines.en: Violet light strikes the sand and my rings go numb.

lines.zh: 沙里没吃的，我开始啃石头。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the sand, so I gnaw stone.

lines.zh: 雷打中沙面，玻璃结了一圈。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and glass rings form.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙没了，我的牙空咬。
lines.en: No sand here. My teeth bite nothing.
